one_month_reasoning: No company-scheduled catalyst falls between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-30: Q3 FY26 was reported Sept 10 (small beat, Q4 revenue guide slightly below consensus, stock -2.7% premarket), Adobe MAX is Nov 10-12 and Q4 FY26 earnings (with the first FY27 targets, likely under incoming CEO Chakravarthy from Dec 1) are expected ~Dec 9, all outside the window. The Q3 10-Q (filed Sept 22) is already out. Remaining movers are macro prints, peer software earnings in late October, and sector sentiment around AI disruption of seat-based software. Adobe is buying back ~$2.2B/quarter (~9.5M shares in Q3), a mild support. With no scheduled event I centre the distribution on today's $237.96 (P(>=spot)=0.50) with a symmetric lognormal spread at ~11.7% monthly vol (41%/3.5), slightly fattened tails.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (60%: ~$30.5 NTM non-GAAP EPS as of Sept 2027 x 9.5x = $290) and owner FCF yield (40%: ~$24/share FCF after SBC at a 9% yield = $268), giving ~$281.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sept 2027 ~$30.5 (FY27 consensus $27.67 grown ~11% into FY28, weighted 1/4 FY27 + 3/4 FY28) x 9.5x

inputs_detail.derivation: Organic ARR growth ~8-9% (Q3 ARR $27.50B +11.2% incl. ~$480M Semrush from Q2 10-Q; ex-Semrush ~9.3%; FY guide 10.2% on $25.66B beginning book implies ~8.3% organic) plus ~3-5% share-count shrink from $2.2B/quarter buybacks and $24.55B remaining authorization, with ~45% non-GAAP op margin held flat and 18% fixed non-GAAP tax rate through FY28.

Stock today trades ~8.8x NTM EPS (~$27) and ~9.7x FY26 guide; I allow a modest re-rating (~0.7x) for a stable 10%+ EPS grower with ~10% FCF yield, but not a return to historical 25x+ given net new ARR down 36-37% y/y and AI-disruption debate. Analyst average target ~$278-283 implies ~10x.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY27 CFO ~$11.2B, capex ~$0.35B, less SBC ~$2.3B = ~$8.6B owner FCF; ~360M diluted shares by Sept 2027 = ~$24/share; 9% required yield

inputs_detail.derivation: FY26 CFO run-rate ~$10.2B grown ~9% to ~$11.2B, less ~$0.35B capex (Q3 $85M x4) and ~$2.3B SBC (Q3 $539M x4, +5%).
389.2M outstanding at Sept 18, 2026 (10-Q cover); Q3 repurchased ~9.5M shares for $2.23B; continuing ~$8-9B/yr at ~$240-280 retires ~32M, net of ~4M issuance.
Debt $1.60B current + $4.77B long-term vs $5.64B cash and short-term investments at Aug 28, 2026; immaterial to per-share value.
Current market cap ~$92.6B (389.2M x $237.96) vs ~$7.9B FY26 FCF after SBC = ~8.5% yield; 9% assumes no re-rating from today, i.e. value accrues only via FCF growth and share shrink.

bear.story: Freemium strategy keeps cannibalising paid Creative conversion; net new ARR keeps falling y/y, organic ARR growth slides to ~5-6%, new CEO resets FY27 targets lower in December and margins dip on AI compute; EPS ~$26 NTM valued at ~6.5x as the market treats Adobe as an ex-growth, AI-disrupted seat business.

base.story: Q4 delivers the 10.2% ARR guide with the seasonal enterprise step-up; FY27 targets land near consensus (~$27.7 EPS, high-single-digit revenue growth); buybacks shrink shares ~8%/yr; multiple stays ~9x on ~$30 NTM EPS.

bull.story: AI-first ARR (>$650M, +150%) and Firefly/Acrobat AI monetisation plus deferred Creative Cloud pricing actions re-accelerate net new ARR in FY27; Chakravarthy's agentic/CX story gains credibility; multiple recovers to ~12x on ~$31 EPS.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$178 (under the 52-week low of $190 and ~6.5x FY27 consensus EPS) the market would be pricing an actual decline in earnings power, e.g. FY27 targets implying ARR growth in low single digits, negative net new ARR in a quarter, or a margin reset from AI costs, rather than just multiple compression; the valuation-and-buyback support in my base case would then be invalid.

reasoning: Primary documents show a business still compounding EPS double digits but with decelerating organic bookings. Q3 FY26 (8-K/10-Q): revenue $6.76B +13%, non-GAAP EPS $6.13 +15%, ARR $27.50B +11.2%, RPO +8%, cRPO +9%; Q3 deferred revenue change was -$46M vs +$200M a year ago; FY guide raised to $24.45-24.50 EPS with ARR growth held at 10.2% on a $25.66B beginning book. The Q2 10-Q discloses ~$480M of ARR came from Semrush, so organic ARR growth is ~9% now and ~8% for the full-year guide. On the call analysts cited net new ARR down 36-37% y/y; management attributed it to steering traffic into the freemium funnel (creative freemium MAU >100M, +70%) and deferring Creative Cloud pricing actions, with Q4 net new ARR guided above Q3. Offsets: ~$2.2B/quarter buybacks (26.1M shares repurchased in 9M, $24.55B authorization left, 389.2M shares out), net debt only ~$0.7B, FCF yield ~10%+ pre-SBC. CEO transition (Chakravarthy from Dec 1) plus interim CFO adds event risk at the Dec 9 FY27 guide. Valuation: at ~8.8x NTM EPS the stock prices meaningful decline risk; a 60/40 P/E and FCF-yield blend gives ~$281 fair value, and consensus targets ~$278-283 are similar. I set the 12-month median at ~$255 (below fair value, because sentiment and the bookings trend argue for only partial convergence) with scenario mean ~$266, and a ~36% lognormal-like width (below the 41% realized vol since part of that came from a one-off de-rating, but fat left tail kept for a guide reset). Research was limited: Alpha Vantage was rate-limited and Twelve Data analyst endpoints were paywalled, so consensus comes from StockAnalysis/Benzinga pages.
